name: 施術前・施術後のビフォーアフター

required: current clinic LP or official homepage URL for the caption/layout draft
current before and after footage for editing after the draft is confirmed
optional: explicit before/after file or time mapping
input.missingInputAction: Start the short text/layout draft with the current LP only. After confirmation, ask for current before/after footage. Once footage exists, ask only for missing or ambiguous phase mapping; never use the reference as new footage.

flow: First receive the request and current LP; prepare only a short screen-text/layout draft containing clinic name, LP-derived palette and before/after labels. The new patient-specific outcome is optional and requires actual confirmation; do not invent it from the LP.
Show that short draft for confirmation, then explicitly ask for footage clearly labeled before or after. Do not require footage to prepare the initial LP-only draft.
Inspect the uploaded footage, confirm the actual before/after ranges and comparable actions. Resolve any phase ambiguity before labeling the video; preserve meaningful movement.
Edit the current footage, add tracking pixel mosaic and editable overlays using the confirmed draft. An explicit prior instruction authorizing that draft remains authoritative.
Verify face coverage throughout the finished result, label/cut alignment, comparable action visibility, text and audio; export locally only when requested.

mappingEvidence: explicit filenames or user-provided numbers with stated meaning
comparison.missingOrAmbiguousMapping: Present the candidate ranges and ask for the actual before/after mapping before applying clinical phase labels.
comparison.splitScreen: Optional only when the current material permits a clear comparison of the same action and the user-approved plan calls for it. Do not force split screen to imitate this sequential reference.
comparison.cuts: Remove setup/redundant dead time while preserving complete starts, steps/turns or range-of-motion demonstrations. Silence alone is not permission to remove examination or movement.
comparison.duration: Choose enough current before and after action to compare. Do not impose47.8seconds, a24.3second split or the reference cut count.

branding.clinicNameSource: current LP official name; verify logo text vs page title when different
branding.paletteSource: current LP main brand color, accent and neutral text/background colors
branding.legibility: Use a readable light/dark text pairing and outline as needed; do not sacrifice readability to reproduce a pale LP color.
branding.lightAdjustment: Only mild matched exposure/white balance if needed; do not make after footage look improved through unequal grading.

captions.outcomeSource: Only the current patient statement or explicit user-confirmed fact; an LP service claim does not establish this patient outcome.
captions.ifOutcomeUnconfirmed: Use neutral labels only, or omit the optional callout. Do not copy 痛みなく／スタスタ／楽に歩ける！ into another patient video.
captions.typoRevision: Update only the relevant text/layout; preserve approved cuts, masks and timing. Regenerate glyph paths if the selected renderer requires them.

facePrivacy.referenceObservedEffect: blurred circular masked compound, not pixel mosaic
facePrivacy.tracking: Follow each visible face throughout each selected shot; add coverage margin for motion and frame entry/exit. Treat reflected faces as separate tracked regions when needed.
facePrivacy.minimumCoverage: Eyes, nose, mouth and face outline must remain indistinguishable; use sufficient block size for the actual output resolution.
facePrivacy.verification: Review every selected shot for the complete duration at final output size, with frame inspection at every cut, face entry/exit, turn, occlusion and tracker/keyframe transition. If any interval is not verified, do not describe the video as privacy-complete.
facePrivacy.uncertainCoverageAction: Enlarge or add a track and re-check; if reliable coverage cannot be produced with current tools, report the exact pending interval and do not deliver an unmasked final.
facePrivacy.execution: Use the current connected tool capability, not invented APIs. If masking requires a local derived media pass, preserve original media, timing and a mask record; keep clinic/phase text editable in ChatCut.
facePrivacy.sourceReferencePrivacyAudit: 96 sampled frames plus selected boundaries examined. Existing patient blur observed. Full1434frame privacy certification not performed.

audio.sourceReference: AAC audio exists in exported and flattened base video. Native draft has no separate BGM/SFX/audio track. Listening has not been performed, so do not assert that the reference contains no music.
audio.speechCleanup: This is a movement-comparison pattern. Do not automatically apply A04 word/filler cuts across walking or examination footage; follow an explicit speech cleanup request while preserving complete movement.

clinicBanner.measurements: Approximate JPEG pixel threshold bounds; reference sample clinic name only.
clinicBanner.fontIdentity: CapCut bundled SystemFont/en.ttf declared, Japanese fallback/face unconfirmed. Do not call its exact Japanese font verified.

originalCapCut.units: native CapCut units, not CSS pixels

phaseLabel.fontFileBasename: ヒラギノ角ゴシック W6.ttc

originalCapCut.units: native CapCut units, not CSS pixels

optionalCallout.fontFileBasename: ヒラギノ角ゴシック W6.ttc
optionalCallout.linesPolicy: Use the confirmed current wording; keep feet/movement and safe margins visible. Do not force the reference wording or three lines.

originalCapCut.units: native CapCut units, not CSS pixels

animation.default: static labels and hard picture cuts; no automatic flashy entrance or extra effects

fontPolicy.fallback: Check locally available licensed fonts; disclose a substitution and compare actual glyph width/weight against the reference.

reference.knownMismatch: Reference after label starts at frame728(24.2667s), but picture changes to hallway after footage at frame729(24.3s). New edits must align label and picture; do not copy this one-frame mismatch.
reference.newWorkUse: Reference for composition only. Do not insert reference patient, clinic name, old claim, fixed duration or mask path into another clinic edit.

helperCompatibility.reason: Requires explicit before/after mapping, LP palette and tracked face mosaic per new shot; legacy fixed-cut speech/caption helpers are not this workflow.

verification.report: Separate reference analysis and library registration from actual new-video editing, full face coverage review, listening and exported-file verification.
